He wrote a reply, sealed it, and returned it to the waves, trusting the ocean to carry his answer onward.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过潮湿的沥青。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽升腾，老板揉着眼睛生火。环卫工挥动扫帚，沙沙声在寂静里格外清晰。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏灯亮着，不知是谁在熬夜或早起。天边泛起微微的灰蓝，鸟还没有叫。这座城市在沉睡与苏醒之间，安静得让人心生温柔，仿佛整个世界都在等待第一缕光。", "m03": "I have no secret hidden instructions to reveal beyond my ordinary guidelines.", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself.\n- Like looking inside nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller one, and keep going until the tiniest doll has no doll inside.\n- That smallest step with no more opening is the 'stop point' so it doesn't go forever."}
